name: pardesline
tagline: 3D vision and medical imaging: 43 public datasets with licences, 73 algorithms on clouds, meshes, CT/MRI
description:
A local MCP server for 3D computer vision and medical imaging (Apache-2.0). It browses and loads 43 public datasets (Medical Segmentation Decathlon, TotalSegmentator, AMOS, LUNA16, TCIA collections, OpenNeuro, KITTI, Objaverse, Hugging Face repos) with their licence and citation, one case at a time. It runs 73 documented algorithms on point clouds, meshes and CT/MRI volumes: registration, surface reconstruction, segmentation, signed distance fields, LiDAR clustering. When a private folder is scanned, the questions it will not guess (licence, units, label meanings) come back to the agent for the human. It also ships 20 expert guides (registration, PointNet, DINOv3, JEPA, Gaussian splatting, nnU-Net, 3D metrics).

Tools: `list_datasets`, `describe_dataset`, `list_samples`, `load_sample`, `scan_dataset`, `confirm_dataset`, `export_dataset`, `list_methods`, `describe_method`, `run_method`, `describe_object`, `to_mesh`, `list_skills`, `get_skill`. Requires Python 3.10 to 3.13; installs with uvx. Nothing leaves the machine except the downloads you ask for.

env.name: HF_TOKEN
env.description: Only for gated Hugging Face datasets whose terms you accepted (AbdomenAtlas, CT-RATE).

install.notes: The first start downloads Open3D, PyVista and SimpleITK. For a lighter server that only browses datasets and guides, replace pardesline[all] with pardesline[mcp].
